PostgreSQL_0:
SELECT account_id
FROM trans
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT trans_id) >= 2
   AND MAX(amount) - MIN(amount) > 12000;
PostgreSQL_4:
UPDATE transactions_1k
SET amount = transactions_1k.amount + 10
FROM customers
WHERE transactions_1k.customerid = customers.customerid
AND transactions_1k.transactionid IN (SELECT transactionid FROM transactions_1k LIMIT 1)
RETURNING transactions_1k.transactionid, customers.Segment;
